process_phases.name: Intake & storage
process_phases.intro: Water is received into the raw water tank, given a first disinfection and allowed to settle before treatment begins.

process_phases.name: Filtration
process_phases.intro: Sand, carbon and cartridge filters remove sediment, chlorine, odour and colour, step by step.

process_phases.name: Purification & sterilisation
process_phases.intro: Membranes, fine filters, ultraviolet light and ozone deal with bacteria, viruses and spores.

process_phases.name: Fill & quality
process_phases.intro: Bottles are rinsed, filled and capped by machine, tested, then sealed and packed for distribution.

process_steps.title: Raw water harvesting
process_steps.body: Water is drawn from our protected source and screened to remove leaves, dust and other debris.

process_steps.title: Chlorine doser
process_steps.body: A measured dose of sodium hypochlorite gives the water its first line of disinfection.

process_steps.title: Raw water tank
process_steps.body: The water rests in primary storage so that suspended particles can settle before treatment.

process_steps.title: Pressure sand filter
process_steps.body: Removes suspended matter and improves clarity. The filter cleans itself with an automatic back-wash.

process_steps.title: Activated carbon filter
process_steps.body: Takes out the remaining chlorine along with odour, colour and trace organic compounds.

process_steps.title: Pre-micron filters
process_steps.body: Cartridge filters trap finer sediment and parasite eggs that earlier stages let through.

process_steps.title: High pressure pump
process_steps.body: Pushes the pre-filtered water into the reverse osmosis system at a carefully controlled pressure.

process_steps.title: Ultra filtration
process_steps.body: A fine membrane holds back bacteria and most viruses.

process_steps.title: Post-micron filters
process_steps.body: An even finer cartridge removes viruses, bacterial cells and mould spores.

process_steps.title: UV steriliser
process_steps.body: Ultraviolet lamps neutralise any bacteria that remain in the water.

process_steps.title: Ozonator
process_steps.body: Ozone treatment gives a final disinfection, reacting far faster than chemical methods.

process_steps.title: Filling section
process_steps.body: Machines rinse, fill and cap every bottle and jar automatically.

process_steps.title: QC lab
process_steps.body: Each batch is tested in our own laboratory and checked by a BIS-approved external lab before release.

process_steps.title: Finished product
process_steps.body: Sealed bottles move along automatic conveyors to be packed and sent out for distribution.
